name: brivya
description: Infrastructure for the Agentic Business Web.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @brivya/core && npm run build -w @brivya/manifest
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @brivya/core && npm run typecheck -w @brivya/manifest
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/dist/test/*.test.js packages/manifest/dist/test/*.test.js
